<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/sellers/{sellerId}/capacity-allocations"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The seller's inbound capacity reservations of one calendar month (ADR 0015): the dm3 its `DRAFT` and `CONFIRMED` plans
promise to each node. `CreateInboundPlan` reserves, `CancelInboundPlan` releases, confirmation keeps the hold; a
reservation lives in the month of the plan's `createdAt`, so the allocation rolls over with the key. The read is the
operator-facing honesty surface of the monthly capacity gate and publishes no event.

`month` is a `YYYY-MM` key and defaults to the current month. The gate itself is enforced only when the node's declared
monthly volume AND every line's seller-declared `unitVolumeDm3` are known; otherwise the plan is allowed and carries
`capacityEnforced: false` (record-and-allow, ADR 0015).
